newsitem.title: USA: Disney World nightclub to become tax office.
newsitem.headline: Disney World nightclub to become tax office.

text.p: Tax deadline looming but you want to dance the night away?
Fine. Disney World says you can have it both ways.

Disney's Pleasure Island, a six-acre nightclub complex on Lake Buena Vista, is bringing Internal Revenue Service representatives with laptop computers to answer questions and file forms electronically before the midnight deadline.
IRS spokesman Holger Euringer predicted that most of those forms will be Form 4868 extensions, giving the filer another four months to do the real work.
He warned partiers to bring their checkbooks. To avoid paying interest on their taxes, filers should pay as much of the estimated tax as possible.

But for those taxpayers who might be stopped by a few last minute questions, those IRS representatives should be able to speed you on your way to the dance floor, Euringer said. People can also mail their returns from Pleasure Island until midnight.
